# Packages

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lmtest)
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)
library(stringr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(ARTool)
library(multcomp)
library(multcompView)
```

# Data
## Load data
```{r}

dat_bx <- read.table("04_over_midrib/01_data/20261102_PM_SH_over_the_midrib.csv", 
                       sep = ",", fill = TRUE)
```

## Wrangle data

1. Make a column "comp" which contains the compound name
```{r}
dat_bx1 <- dat_bx |>
  mutate(comp = if_else(
    str_detect(V1, "^Compound \\d+:"),  # indentify rows starting with "Compound <number>:"
    str_remove(V1, "^Compound \\d+:\\s*"),  # removes the "Compound <number>:" prefix, leaving only the compound name
    NA_character_
  )) |>
  fill(comp, .direction = "down")  # put the compound name into the "comp" column, until the next "Compound <number>:" row

```

2. Remove unnecessary rows, rename columns

```{r}
dat_bx2 <- dat_bx1 |>
  filter(str_starts(V1, "2026"))  # this filters for rows in V1 that start with "2026"

colnames(dat_bx2) <- c("name", "ug_mL", "comp")
```

3. Separate "name" column to obtain sample info

```{r}
dat_bx3 <- dat_bx2 |>
  separate(col = "name",
           into = c("date", "analyst", "technician", "over", "the", "midrib", "genotype", "segment", "treat_rep"),
           sep = "_") |>
  separate(col = "treat_rep",
           into = c("treat", "rep"),
           sep = "(?<=\\D)(?=\\d)")

dat_bx4 <- dat_bx3[,!names(dat_bx3) %in% c("over", "the", "midrib")]

```

4. Transform ug/mL to ug/g FW:

(We extracted 30 ug tissue in 300 uL extraction buffer, and then we diluted this 1:10. This means we have 10 mg of tissue per mL of extraction buffer in the end. 
To get ug per gram fresh weight, we calculate ug/mL * 100 = ug/g FW)

```{r}
dat_bx4$ug_mL <- as.numeric(dat_bx4$ug_mL)

dat_bx5 <- dat_bx4 |>
  mutate(ug_g_fw = ug_mL * 100)

```

```{r}
dat_bx6 <- dat_bx5 %>%
  mutate(
    genotype = factor(genotype, levels = c("KN", "haci", "lox")),
    treat = factor(treat, levels = c("c", "w")),
    comp = factor(comp)
  )
```

```{r}
dat_bx7 <- subset(dat_bx6, !is.na(rep))
```

```{r}
dat_bx7 <- dat_bx7 |>
  mutate(plant_id = interaction(genotype, treat, rep, drop = TRUE, sep = "_"))
```


## Check data

```{r}
# Check blanks:

which(dat_bx5$ug_mL > 0)

which(dat_bx5$ug_mL %in% c("BLANK1", "BLANK2") > 0)

```

# Analysis & Plots

## 1. Comparison between segments: Are BXs induced by GLVs over the midrib (without any vascular connection)?

The answer is no lmao. -> I should probably do metabolomics and look into other markers of induction/priming; since BXs are very localized, but can be induced by GLVs idk man.

```{r}
# Exploratory plot
ggplot(dat_bx7, aes(x = interaction(genotype, treat),
                   y = ug_g_fw)) +
  geom_jitter(width = 0.12, height = 0, size = 2, alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~ comp, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    x = "Experimental group",
    y = "Concentration (µg/g fresh weight)",
    title = "Targeted metabolite concentrations"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

model:

```{r}


# make log-transformed:

dat_bx8$log_ug_g_fw <- log1p(dat_bx8$ug_g_fw)

# Square root
dat_bx8$sqrt_ug_g_fw <- sqrt(dat_bx8$ug_g_fw)

# Log10 with pseudocount
dat_bx8$log10_ug_g_fw <- log10(dat_bx8$ug_g_fw + 0.01)

# Fit a separate model for each compound
models <- dat_bx8 %>%
  group_by(comp) %>%
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- lmer(
      log_ug_g_fw ~ genotype * treat * segment +
        (1 | plant_id),
      data = .x
    )

    emm <- emmeans(
      model,
      ~ treat * segment | genotype
    )

    results <- pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")

    as.data.frame(results)
  }) %>%
  ungroup()


```

Check the fit of the models:
```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

for (compounds1 in unique(dat_bx8$comp)) {
  
  dat_one <- dat_bx8 %>%
    filter(comp == compounds1)
  
  model <- lmer(
      ug_g_fw ~ genotype * treat * segment +
        (1 | plant_id),
      data = dat_one
    )
  
  plot(
    model,
    main = compounds1
  )
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))

for (compounds1 in unique(dat_bx8$comp)) {

  dat_one <- dat_bx8 %>%
    filter(comp == compounds1)

  model <- lmer(
    log_ug_g_fw ~ genotype * treat * segment +
      (1 | plant_id),
    data = dat_one
  )

  qqnorm(residuals(model), main = compound)
  qqline(residuals(model))
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
par(mfrow = c(2, 4))

for (compounds1 in unique(dat_bx8$comp)) {

  dat_one <- dat_bx8 %>%
    filter(comp == compounds1)

  model <- lmer(
    log_ug_g_fw ~ genotype * treat * segment +
      (1 | plant_id),
    data = dat_one
  )

  # Normality of residuals
  qqnorm(residuals(model), main = paste(compounds1, "- QQ plot"))
  qqline(residuals(model))

  # Homogeneity of variance
  plot(
    fitted(model),
    residuals(model),
    main = paste(compounds1, "- Variance"),
    xlab = "Fitted values",
    ylab = "Residuals"
  )
  abline(h = 0, lty = 2)
}

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

```{r}
transformations <- c(
  "log_ug_g_fw",
  "log10_ug_g_fw",
  "sqrt_ug_g_fw"
)

diagnostics <- lapply(unique(dat_bx8$comp), function(compounds1) {
  
  lapply(transformations, function(trans) {
  
  dat_one <- dat_bx8 %>%
    filter(comp == compounds1)
  
   model_formula <- as.formula(
      paste(trans, "~ genotype * treat * segment + (1 | plant_id)")
    )
  
   model <- lmer(
      model_formula,
      data = dat_one
    )

  
  # model <- lmer(
  #   log_ug_g_fw ~ genotype * treat * segment +
  #     (1 | plant_id),
  #   data = dat_one
  # )
  
  # Shapiro-Wilk on model residuals
  
   r <- residuals(model)
  
  shapiro_p <- NA_real_
  
  if (length(r) >= 3 && length(unique(r)) > 1) {
    shapiro_p <- shapiro.test(r)$p.value
  }
  
  # Levene's test across experimental groups
  
   levene <- car::leveneTest(
      as.formula(
        paste(trans, "~ interaction(genotype, treat, segment)")
      ),
      data = dat_one,
      center = median
    )

    levene_p <- levene[1, "Pr(>F)"]
  
  # levene_p <- NA_real_
  # 
  # if (nrow(dat_one) > 1) {
  #   levene <- car::leveneTest(
  #     log_ug_g_fw ~ interaction(genotype, treat, segment),
  #     data = dat_one,
  #     center = median
  #   )
  # 
  #   levene_p <- levene[1, "Pr(>F)"]
  # }

  tibble(
    compound = compounds1,
    shapiro_p = shapiro_p,
    levene_p = levene_p
  )
  })
})

diagnostics <- bind_rows(diagnostics)
```

```{r}
# log1p transform:

dat_bx8$log_ug_g_fw <- log1p(dat_bx8$ug_g_fw)

# set up model
models <- dat_bx8 |>
  group_by(comp) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- lmer(
      log_ug_g_fw ~ genotype * treat * segment +
        (1 | plant_id),
      data = .x
    )

    emm <- emmeans(
      model,
      ~ treat * segment | genotype
    )

    # results <- pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")
    results <- cld(object = emm,
                           adjust = "Tukey",
                           Letters = letters,
                           alpha = 0.05)

    as.data.frame(results)
  }) |>
  ungroup()


models

```

```{r}
# make df for plot:

cld_data <- models |>
  left_join(
    dat_bx8 |>
      group_by(comp, genotype, treat, segment) |>
      summarise(
        y = max(ug_g_fw, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ),
    by = c("comp", "genotype", "treat", "segment")
  ) |>
  mutate(y = y + 0.1 * abs(y))
```


```{r}
summary_plot <- ggplot(dat_bx8, aes (x = treat, y = ug_g_fw, fill = segment)) +
  facet_wrap(~ genotype + comp, scales = "free_y") +
  geom_boxplot(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1
  ) +
  geom_text(
  data = cld_data,
  aes(x = treat, y = y, label = .group, group = segment),
  position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
  inherit.aes = FALSE,
  size = 4
) +
  geom_jitter( 
             position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.15,
                                             dodge.width = 0.8),
             alpha = 0.4,
             shape = 16
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(palette[2], palette[4])) +
  theme(text = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_rect(fill = "white", colour = "white"),
        axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 16),
        axis.text.x = element_text(color = 'black'),
        axis.text.y = element_text(color = 'black')) +
  labs(x = "Genotype", y = "µg/g FW", fill = "Treatment")

summary_plot
```


## 2. Comparison of quantities between genotypes:

Make CLD for this:

```{r}
# log1p transform:

dat_bx8$log_ug_g_fw <- log1p(dat_bx8$ug_g_fw)

# set up model
models_genotype <- dat_bx8 |>
  group_by(comp) |>
  group_modify(~ {
    model <- lmer(
      log_ug_g_fw ~ genotype * treat * segment +
        (1 | plant_id),
      data = .x
    )

    emm <- emmeans(
      model,
      ~ segment * genotype | treat
    )

    # results <- pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey")
    results <- cld(object = emm,
                           adjust = "Tukey",
                           Letters = letters,
                           alpha = 0.05)

    as.data.frame(results)
  }) |>
  ungroup()


models_genotype

```
